license.conditions: The repository's LICENSE (read on GitHub and on Codeberg on 2026-11-12) puts HYG v4.0 and later under this licence: credit the work and share an adaptation under the same licence.

sources.note: The file hyg/CURRENT/hygdata_v41.csv of github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database at the commit the url names, 33,932,548 bytes, fetched at 2026-11-12T14:51:33Z. That repository is archived; HYG now lives at codeberg.org/astronexus/hyg, whose current version is v4.4. Read: id, hip, hd, hr, mag and the designation fields bayer, flam and con, with bf as a check; the README says they come primarily from the Yale Bright Star Catalogue, fifth edition, with Flamsteed numbers added from Wagman (1987).

files.note: The Bayer letters and Flamsteed numbers of 3,303 HYG v4.1 rows, keyed by HIP number, in HIP order, evidenceKind 'catalog-derived', every value as HYG wrote it (hip, flam, bayer, con, hd, hr, id); nothing else is in this file. Of 3,321 designated HYG rows, set aside: 17 without a HIP number and 1 whose bf disagrees with its own fields. Which tile row each HIP number names is in ../designation-links/links.json, ESA data under its own record. Offered under CC BY-SA 4.0 with HYG's attribution (HYG Database, astronexus, codeberg.org/astronexus/hyg), as it is adapted from HYG.
